message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code fetches data from Twitter and Google Maps APIs using API keys for authentication, but there is no checksum verification, content integrity check, or pinned revision for any remote data source.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparisons, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are visible anywhere in the data preparation code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs tweet condensation and user selection but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering on the training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: No code in the provided snippets loads pretrained weights or serialized models with any hash check, signature verification, pinned revision, or controlled-source enforcement.
No detected label distribution validation: No code in the visible pipeline checks class balance, validates label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no evidence of trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in any of the visible code files.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are present anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation in the visible code.

No detected input sanitization: The code reads configuration and API keys with some null checks, but there is no visible input sanitization or validation of incoming inference requests (shape, range, or schema checks) in the shown data-flow path.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model outputs for probability bounds, NaN guards, or calibrated thresholds before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses personality-inference models (IBM Watson) rather than an LLM with free-text prompts, and no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation is present in the shown code.
